mascot.note: The official Paulex mascot (a minimal character in a navy circle), 1254x1254 RGBA with a transparent surround, committed byte for byte as supplied by the owner. It is never redrawn or recoloured: the site only scales it (astro:assets) for the header and the footer.

icons.what: Derived from the official mascot with sharp: the circle cropped from its transparent surround (extract left 111, top 122, 1033x1033), scaled with lanczos3. favicon-32 and icon-192 keep the transparency; apple-touch-icon (180) is flattened on the white of --paper, since iOS fills a transparent icon with black.
